package.name: vla_bridge
package.description:
ROS adapter for the OmniVLA navigation policy. Feeds the policy server an observation history and a goal (2D pose, egocentric image, or language), decodes the returned waypoint chunk into a nav_msgs/Path in the odom frame, and hands that to Nav2's existing MPPI controller via FollowPath.
The policy itself runs in omnivla_server, a separate non-ROS process, so nothing here imports torch. All geometry and decoding lives in plain Python modules beside the nodes; the node files handle only parameters, pub/sub, TF, action clients and message conversion.
Publishes no transforms. The EKF keeps odom -> base_link and the active mapper keeps map -> odom, exactly as with Nav2.
